codeReview.summary: The feature adds the booking deep link, clipboard copy affordance, URL/tab sync changes, extra dev membership data, and refreshed tests, but it does not actually verify or guarantee the required restaurant-switch reset/reload behavior and the updated Playwright/dev-harness validation remains broken in this commit.

issues.description: The only restaurant-switch regression test was weakened to assert call counts stay at 1 after switching restaurants, which means it explicitly does not verify the required behavior that all tab state resets and data reloads for the newly selected restaurant. This leaves expected behavior (3) untested and likely still broken.

The feature requirement said to update the dev-harness E2E test to work with the new tab-based layout, but the handoff confirms this spec still could not run because Playwright always tried to start a second Next dev server and failed on `.next/dev/lock`. A validation spec that cannot execute in the shared mission environment does not satisfy the requested deterministic harness verification.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The `fullstack-worker` skill requires agent-browser verification of the implemented UI, but the worker only confirmed that `/dev/ops-email-delivery` still rendered shell links and then stopped. The skill/procedure does not currently explain how to proceed when the dev harness is stale or how to verify against the authenticated surface while still satisfying the harness requirement.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff `skillFeedback.deviations` says manual verification only confirmed the failure mode because the harness was not fully restored in the live runtime; `.factory/skills/fullstack-worker/SKILL.md` step 7 only says to open the harness or authenticated route and verify visually.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared services manifest documents only `pnpm dev` for the web service, but Playwright validation in this mission needs a stable way to reuse the existing port-3000 server instead of launching another Next instance. Without that guidance, workers hit the recurring `.next/dev/lock` failure.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff `discoveredIssues` and verification show `npx playwright test tests/e2e/ops-email-delivery-dev-harness.spec.ts` failed because config.webServer tried to launch another `next dev`; `.factory/services.yaml` contains no alternate command or note for reusing an already-running server.

summary: Review failed: the commit improves cross-area UI affordances, but it does not prove the required restaurant-switch reset/data reload behavior and the updated Playwright dev-harness validation remained non-runnable due to the unresolved shared-server lock conflict.
